literature.headline_zh: 尼帕病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期尼帕病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 特征集显示编码子计数特征之间存在极高的成对共线性。决策树回归表现最佳(R2 = 0.9945),其次是线性回归(R2 = 0.9908)、随机森林(R2 = 0.9892)、LSTM(R2 = 0.9731)和SimpleRNN(R2 = 0.9718),而KNN(R2 = 0.8038)和SVM/SVR(R2 = 0.1038,经过特征缩放)表现较差。 [10.21203/rs.3.rs-10926709/v1]
证据一致表明,在尼帕病毒感染中存在一个有序的过渡过程,其中病毒核酸从血液中的清除先于病毒特异性免疫球蛋白G的出现,且在初次就诊时检测到病毒血症而免疫球蛋白G缺失的组合具有不良预后意义。 [10.56557/ajocr/2026/v11i411191]
本研究识别出几种来自Tinospora cordifolia的合成小分子,显示出抑制尼帕病毒融合的潜力,尽管未提供实验验证。 [10.21428/3c290898.e634923a]
将这两种物种的计算参数与之前研究的病毒进行比较,可以按照其对ATG分布变化的敏感性递增顺序排列为:严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2、中东呼吸综合征冠状病毒、尼帕病毒、埃博拉病毒和登革病毒,这与它们被观察和认可的突变性一致。 [10.36922/gpd026270023]

在72名护理专业学生中,62.5%的学生听说过尼帕病毒,而63.9%的学生正确识别其为病毒感染。约80.6%的学生了解其传播方式。52.8%的学生对尼帕病毒的自然宿主有充分认知。大多数(68.1%)学生认为脑炎是该感染的重要并发症。避免食用部分腐烂的水果(73.6%)、使用个人防护装备(83.3%)、手卫生(76.4%)以及病例隔离(84.7%)等预防措施被广泛认可。大多数(61.1%)学生通过社交媒体获取了关于这种致命病毒的信息。 [10.37939/jrmc.v30i3.3229]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: The feature set showed very high degrees of pairwise collinearity in the set of codon-count features. [10.21203/rs.3.rs-10926709/v1]

The evidence consistently indicates an ordered transition in Nipah virus infection where viral nucleic acid clearance from blood precedes the appearance of virus-specific immunoglobulin G, and the combination of detectable viraemia with absent immunoglobulin G at presentation carries adverse prognostic weight. [10.56557/ajocr/2026/v11i411191]

The study identified several synthetic small molecules from Tinospora cordifolia that showed potential for inhibiting Nipah virus fusion, though no experimental validation was provided. [10.21428/3c290898.e634923a]

These calculated parameters for the two species mentioned are compared with those of previously studied viruses, allowing them to be arranged in the following order based on their increasing sensitivity to variations in ATG distribution: Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2, Middle East Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus, Nipah, Ebola, and dengue viruses, which is in good accordance with their observed and recognized mutability. [10.36922/gpd026270023]

Of the 72 nursing students, 62.5% of the students had heard about Nipah virus, while 63.9% correctly identified it as a viral infection. About 80.6% knew about its transmission to others. 52.8% were adequately aware of the natural reservoirs of Nipah virus. [10.37939/jrmc.v30i3.3229]
literature.trend_or_risk_en: The direction of this week's research is defined by the clinical, epidemiological, ecological, diagnostic and molecular topics actually represented by the eligible publications.
literature.brief_en: This literature brief prioritizes papers published in the active reporting window and ranks them by relevance, evidence availability, study quality, recency, and independent-source convergence. Detailed study-specific evidence is retained in the article cards below.

本研究识别出几种来自Tinospora cordifolia的合成小分子,显示出抑制尼帕病毒融合的潜力,尽管未提供实验验证。 [10.21428/3c290898.e634923a]。

brief_items_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
The feature set showed very high degrees of pairwise collinearity in the set of codon-count features. [10.21203/rs.3.rs-10926709/v1].

The evidence consistently indicates an ordered transition in Nipah virus infection where viral nucleic acid clearance from blood precedes the appearance of virus-specific immunoglobulin G, and the combination of detectable viraemia with absent immunoglobulin G at presentation carries adverse prognostic weight.

The study identified several synthetic small molecules from Tinospora cordifolia that showed potential for inhibiting Nipah virus fusion, though no experimental validation was provided. [10.21428/3c290898.e634923a].

These calculated parameters for the two species mentioned are compared with those of previously studied viruses, allowing them to be arranged in the following order based on their increasing sensitivity to variations in ATG distribution: Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2, Middle East Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus, Nipah, Ebola, and dengue viruses, which is in good accordance with their observed and recognized mutability.

news.headline_zh: 尼帕病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态

papers.title: Comparative Analysis of Classical Machine Learning and Deep Learning Regression Models for Codon-Level k-mer Composition Analysis of the Nipah Virus Genome
papers.abstract: Abstract The Nipah virus (NiV) is highly virulent zoonotic paramyxovirus, where a complete genome sequence resource is relatively limited compared to other emerging pathogens. In this study, the codon level (3-mer) k-mer composition analysis of 93 complete Nipah virus genome sequences retrieved from the NCBI Nucleotide database was presented. The genomes were encoded into a vector of 64 elements representing the number of appearances of each of the 64 three-nucleotide combinations. The feature set was subjected to descriptive statistics, covariance and Pearson correlation between each feature, which showed very high degrees of pairwise collinearity in the set of codon-count features. Using a correlation-based feature-selection procedure (|r| > 0.99), the feature space was reduced from 64 to 5 almost independent codon counts (AAA, TAG, TCG, CGC and CCG). We considered seven regression algorithms across three learning paradigms (classical models: Linear Regression, K-Nearest Neighbors, Support Vector Machine/SVR, an ensemble model: Random Forest, deep sequential models: Long Short-Term Memory network and Simple Recurrent Neural Network, and a Decision Tree baseline) and compared their performance using the number of codons CCG as a regression target and the remaining four codon counts as predictors. The 70/20/10 train/validation/test split was used to train all models, and they were compared using the coefficient of determination (R2), root mean squared error (RMSE), and mean absolute error (MAE). Decision Tree Regression achieved the best performance (R2 = 0.9945), followed by Linear Regression (R2 = 0.9908), Random Forest (R2 = 0.9892), LSTM (R2 = 0.9731), and SimpleRNN (R2 = 0.9718), while KNN (R2 = 0.8038) and SVM/SVR (R2 = 0.1038 with feature scaling) underperformed. The results are evaluated with the knowledge of the large compositional constraints on codon usage over a set of Nipah virus genomes, the known sensitivity of instance- and margin-based regressors to unscaled, collinear small-sample data, and the limited benefit of deep sequential architectures on a pseudo-sequence of a very small tabular sample (no temporal dimension). This paper presents in a transparent manner the pipeline results, statistical results and comparative modeling results, along with the limitations of the dataset, as a baseline for future codon-composition based computational studies of Nipah virus.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of classical machine learning and deep learning regression models in analyzing codon-level k-mer composition of the Nipah virus genome, addressing the limited availability of complete genome sequence resources for this virus.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed 93 complete Nipah virus genome sequences retrieved from the NCBI Nucleotide database, focusing on codon-level (3-mer) k-mer composition analysis.
analysis.methods: The genomes were encoded into a vector of 64 elements representing the number of appearances of each of the 64 three-nucleotide combinations. A correlation-based feature-selection procedure (|r| > 0.99) was used to reduce the feature space from 64 to 5 almost independent codon counts. Seven regression algorithms were considered across three learning paradigms and compared using the number of codons CCG as a regression target and the remaining four codon counts as predictors.
analysis.main_results: The feature set showed very high degrees of pairwise collinearity in the set of codon-count features. Decision Tree Regression achieved the best performance (R2 = 0.9945), followed by Linear Regression (R2 = 0.9908), Random Forest (R2 = 0.9892), LSTM (R2 = 0.9731), and SimpleRNN (R2 = 0.9718), while KNN (R2 = 0.8038) and SVM/SVR (R2 = 0.1038 with feature scaling) underperformed.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the results as highlighting the superior performance of Decision Tree Regression and classical models over deep learning models in this context, noting the limited benefit of deep sequential architectures on a pseudo-sequence of a very small tabular sample.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide a baseline for future computational studies on Nipah virus codon-composition analysis, which could inform surveillance, diagnosis, and understanding of viral genomic characteristics.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study acknowledges the large compositional constraints on codon usage and the known sensitivity of instance- and margin-based regressors to unscaled, collinear small-sample data, which may limit the generalizability of the results. The evidence strength is moderate due to these constraints and the lack of temporal dimension in the data.

analysis.summary_en: This study compares classical machine learning and deep learning regression models for codon-level k-mer composition analysis of the Nipah virus genome. It highlights the importance of addressing the limited availability of genome sequence resources for NiV. The analysis involved 93 complete genome sequences, encoded into a 64-element vector. A correlation-based feature selection reduced the feature space to five codon counts. Seven regression algorithms were evaluated, with Decision Tree Regression showing the best performance. The results suggest that classical models outperform deep learning models in this context, possibly due to the small and collinear dataset. The study provides a baseline for future computational research on NiV codon composition, while noting limitations related to data constraints and the lack of temporal dimension.

elements_zh.methods: 基因组被编码为一个包含64个元素的媒介,每个元素代表64种三核苷酸组合的出现次数。采用基于相关性的特征选择过程(|r| > 0.99)将特征空间从64个减少到几乎独立的5个编码子计数。考虑了七种回归算法,涵盖三种学习范式,并以编码子CCG的数量作为回归目标,其余四个编码子计数作为预测变量进行比较。
elements_zh.main_results: 特征集显示编码子计数特征之间存在极高的成对共线性。决策树回归表现最佳(R2 = 0.9945),其次是线性回归(R2 = 0.9908)、随机森林(R2 = 0.9892)、LSTM(R2 = 0.9731)和SimpleRNN(R2 = 0.9718),而KNN(R2 = 0.8038)和SVM/SVR(R2 = 0.1038,经过特征缩放)表现较差。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将结果解释为在这一背景下,决策树回归和经典模型的表现优于深度学习模型,同时指出深度序列架构在非常小的表格样本伪序列上的有限优势。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为未来基于编码子组成的尼帕病毒计算研究提供了基准,可能有助于监测、诊断以及对病毒基因组特征的理解。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究承认了编码子使用的大规模组成约束,以及基于实例和边界回归器对未缩放、共线性小样本数据的敏感性,这可能限制研究结果的普遍适用性。由于这些限制以及数据中缺乏时间维度,证据强度中等。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of classical machine learning and deep learning regression models in analyzing codon-level k-mer composition of the Nipah virus genome, addressing the limited availability of complete genome sequence resources for this virus.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed 93 complete Nipah virus genome sequences retrieved from the NCBI Nucleotide database, focusing on codon-level (3-mer) k-mer composition analysis.
analysis_en.methods: The genomes were encoded into a vector of 64 elements representing the number of appearances of each of the 64 three-nucleotide combinations. A correlation-based feature-selection procedure (|r| > 0.99) was used to reduce the feature space from 64 to 5 almost independent codon counts. Seven regression algorithms were considered across three learning paradigms and compared using the number of codons CCG as a regression target and the remaining four codon counts as predictors.
analysis_en.main_results: The feature set showed very high degrees of pairwise collinearity in the set of codon-count features. Decision Tree Regression achieved the best performance (R2 = 0.9945), followed by Linear Regression (R2 = 0.9908), Random Forest (R2 = 0.9892), LSTM (R2 = 0.9731), and SimpleRNN (R2 = 0.9718), while KNN (R2 = 0.8038) and SVM/SVR (R2 = 0.1038 with feature scaling) underperformed.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the results as highlighting the superior performance of Decision Tree Regression and classical models over deep learning models in this context, noting the limited benefit of deep sequential architectures on a pseudo-sequence of a very small tabular sample.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide a baseline for future computational studies on Nipah virus codon-composition analysis, which could inform surveillance, diagnosis, and understanding of viral genomic characteristics.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study acknowledges the large compositional constraints on codon usage and the known sensitivity of instance- and margin-based regressors to unscaled, collinear small-sample data, which may limit the generalizability of the results. The evidence strength is moderate due to these constraints and the lack of temporal dimension in the data.

papers.title_zh: 经典机器学习与深度学习回归模型在尼帕病毒 基因组编码子序列分析中的比较研究
papers.source_body_en: Abstract The Nipah virus (NiV) is highly virulent zoonotic paramyxovirus, where a complete genome sequence resource is relatively limited compared to other emerging pathogens. In this study, the codon level (3-mer) k-mer composition analysis of 93 complete Nipah virus genome sequences retrieved from the NCBI Nucleotide database was presented. The genomes were encoded into a vector of 64 elements representing the number of appearances of each of the 64 three-nucleotide combinations. The feature set was subjected to descriptive statistics, covariance and Pearson correlation between each feature, which showed very high degrees of pairwise collinearity in the set of codon-count features. Using a correlation-based feature-selection procedure (|r| > 0.99), the feature space was reduced from 64 to 5 almost independent codon counts (AAA, TAG, TCG, CGC and CCG). We considered seven regression algorithms across three learning paradigms (classical models: Linear Regression, K-Nearest Neighbors, Support Vector Machine/SVR, an ensemble model: Random Forest, deep sequential models: Long Short-Term Memory network and Simple Recurrent Neural Network, and a Decision Tree baseline) and compared their performance using the number of codons CCG as a regression target and the remaining four codon counts as predictors. The 70/20/10 train/validation/test split was used to train all models, and they were compared using the coefficient of determination (R2), root mean squared error (RMSE), and mean absolute error (MAE). Decision Tree Regression achieved the best performance (R2 = 0.9945), followed by Linear Regression (R2 = 0.9908), Random Forest (R2 = 0.9892), LSTM (R2 = 0.9731), and SimpleRNN (R2 = 0.9718), while KNN (R2 = 0.8038) and SVM/SVR (R2 = 0.1038 with feature scaling) underperformed. The results are evaluated with the knowledge of the large compositional constraints on codon usage over a set of Nipah virus genomes, the known sensitivity of instance- and margin-based regressors to unscaled, collinear small-sample data, and the limited benefit of deep sequential architectures on a pseudo-sequence of a very small tabular sample (no temporal dimension). This paper presents in a transparent manner the pipeline results, statistical results and comparative modeling results, along with the limitations of the dataset, as a baseline for future codon-composition based computational studies of Nipah virus.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 尼帕病毒(尼帕病毒)是一种高度致病性的动物源性副粘病毒,与其他新兴病原体相比,其完整的基因组序列资源相对有限。本研究展示了从NCBI核苷酸数据库中检索到的93条完整的尼帕病毒 基因组序列的编码子(3-mer)水平的k-mer组成分析。基因组被编码为一个包含64个元素的媒介,每个元素代表64种三核苷酸组合的出现次数。对特征集进行了描述性统计分析,并计算了各特征之间的协方差和皮尔逊相关系数,结果显示该编码子计数特征集内部存在极高的成对共线性。通过基于相关性的特征选择过程(|r| > 0.99),将特征空间从64个减少到几乎独立的5个编码子计数(AAA、TAG、TCG、CGC和CCG)。我们考虑了七种回归算法,涵盖三种学习范式(经典模型:线性回归、K近邻、支持向量机/支持向量回归;集成模型:随机森林;深度序列模型:长短期记忆网络和简单循环神经网络;以及决策树基线模型),并以编码子CCG的数量作为回归目标,其余四个编码子计数作为预测变量进行比较。所有模型均采用70/20/10的训练/验证/测试划分方式进行训练,并通过决定系数(R2)、均方根误差(RMSE)和平均绝对误差(MAE)进行比较。决策树回归表现最佳(R2 = 0.9945),其次是线性回归(R2 = 0.9908)、随机森林(R2 = 0.9892)、LSTM(R2 = 0.9731)和SimpleRNN(R2 = 0.9718),而KNN(R2 = 0.8038)和SVM/SVR(R2 = 0.1038,经过特征缩放)表现较差。这些结果在考虑了编码子使用的大规模组成约束、基于实例和边界回归器对未缩放、共线性小样本数据的敏感性,以及深度序列架构在非常小的表格样本伪序列上的有限优势后进行了评估。本文以透明的方式展示了流程结果、统计结果和比较建模结果,同时列出了数据集的局限性,为未来基于编码子组成的尼帕病毒计算研究提供了基准。

papers.title: Geometrical study of DNA sequences of New World hantavirus and Nipah virus using the ATG genomic walk method
papers.abstract: Viral genome analysis is essential for characterizing genetic variation and evolutionary patterns, while complementary computational approaches may provide additional insights beyond conventional sequence-based methods. In this paper, the complete RNAs of New World hantavirus and Nipah virus are analyzed using a DNA walk method that traces the distribution of ATG triplets along sequences. It provides visual one-dimensional models (ATG trajectories) of genomes on a plane and quantitative estimates based on: (i) point-defined relative values of the divergence of ATG trajectories, (ii) relative global-defined standard deviation of ATG triplet numbers in a studied set of sequences, and (iii) relative global-defined standard deviation of fractal dimension values of inter-ATG distances in the same sequence set. These calculated parameters for the two species mentioned are compared with those of previously studied viruses, allowing them to be arranged in the following order based on their increasing sensitivity to variations in ATG distribution: Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2, Middle East Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus, Nipah, Ebola, and dengue viruses, which is in good accordance with their observed and recognized mutability. The method verified in this paper can be used as a supplementary pre-screening qualitative and quantitative tool for conventional sequencing analysis.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces a novel computational method called the ATG genomic walk to analyze the DNA sequences of New World hantavirus and Nipah virus. The method generates one-dimensional models of genomes and quantifies divergence based on ATG triplet distribution, global standard deviation of triplet numbers, and fractal dimension of inter-ATG distances. The results show that Nipah virus has a higher sensitivity to variations in ATG distribution compared to other viruses like Ebola and dengue, aligning with its known mutability. The authors suggest that this method can serve as a supplementary tool for conventional sequencing analysis, offering insights into genetic variation and evolutionary patterns. However, the study lacks direct clinical or epidemiological outcomes, limiting its evidence strength to moderate. The findings may contribute to improved surveillance and diagnostic strategies for highly mutable viruses such as Nipah virus.

papers.title: Temporal Fusion of RT-qPCR and IgM/IgG Serology for Nipah Virus Diagnosis: A Critical Narrative Review and a Proposed Explainable Artificial Intelligence Framework
papers.abstract: Nipah virus infection is a high-consequence zoonosis of South and South-East Asia for which laboratory confirmation rests on two assay families whose informativeness moves in opposite directions across the course of illness. Reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction performs best while viral nucleic acid remains detectable in blood and the oropharynx, whereas enzyme-linked immunosorbent assays for immunoglobulin M and immunoglobulin G become informative as nucleic acid disappears. Prevailing practice interprets these assays as independent dichotomous results obtained at a single moment, discarding quantitative magnitude, specimen provenance and the day of illness on which each specimen was taken. This review critically evaluates whether the longitudinal structure of the two assay families can be exploited jointly, and what explainable artificial intelligence would need to deliver before such a model could be used in outbreak conditions. Human clinical studies describing the temporal behaviour of molecular and serological markers were appraised alongside the methodological literature on diagnostic accuracy without an adequate reference standard, and the computational literature on temporal and multimodal fusion and on explanation methods in clinical decision support. The evidence consistently indicates an ordered transition in which clearance of viral nucleic acid from blood precedes the appearance of virus-specific immunoglobulin G, and that the combination of detectable viraemia with absent immunoglobulin G at presentation carries adverse prognostic weight. Confidence in these observations is nevertheless constrained by very small samples, over-representation of the minority who survive, the absence of an international nucleic-acid standard, and geographical concentration of evidence in Bangladesh and Kerala. No clinical prediction model that fuses molecular and serological results over time was identified for this infection. A conceptual dynamic framework is developed that separates established temporal relationships from hypothesised gains, specifies the evaluation and governance requirements that would apply, and identifies prospective serial-sampling cohorts as the rate-limiting evidential step rather than model architecture.

papers.abstract_zh: 尼帕病毒感染是一种在南亚和东南亚地区具有高后果性的人兽共患病,其实验室确诊依赖于两个检测方法家族,它们在疾病过程中提供相反方向的信息。逆转录定量聚合酶链反应(RT-qPCR)在病毒核酸仍能在血液和咽部检测到时表现最佳,而免疫球蛋白M和免疫球蛋白G的酶联免疫吸附试验(ELISA)则在核酸消失后变得具有信息量。目前的实践将这些检测视为在单一时间点获得的独立二元结果,忽略了定量数值、样本来源以及每个样本采集时的疾病天数。本综述批判性地评估了这两种检测方法家族的纵向结构是否可以联合利用,并探讨了在暴发条件下使用此类模型之前,可解释人工智能需要提供哪些要素。同时,评估了描述分子和血清学标志物时间行为的人类临床研究,以及在缺乏充分参考标准的情况下关于诊断准确性的方法学文献,以及关于时间与多模态融合和临床决策支持中解释方法的计算文献。证据一致表明,在尼帕病毒感染中存在一个有序的过渡过程,其中病毒核酸从血液中的清除先于病毒特异性免疫球蛋白G的出现,且在初次就诊时检测到病毒血症而免疫球蛋白G缺失的组合具有不良预后意义。然而,这些观察结果的信心仍受到样本量非常小、幸存者过度代表、缺乏国际核酸标准以及证据地理集中于孟加拉国和喀拉拉邦等因素的限制。未发现针对该感染的临床预测模型,该模型能够随时间融合分子和血清学结果。为此,提出了一种概念性的动态框架,该框架区分了已建立的时间关系和假设的收益,明确了适用的评估和治理要求,并确定了前瞻性连续采样队列研究作为证据的关键限制步骤,而非模型架构。

papers.title: Awareness of Nursing Students About Nipah Virus Infection: A Cross-Sectional Study
papers.abstract: Objective: This study aimed to determine the awareness of nursing students regarding Nipah virus infection. Methods: A cross-sectional analytical study was conducted among 72 nursing students from a public sector nursing college. Data were gathered pertaining to their knowledge of the epidemiology, clinical manifestations, complications, and prevention of Nipah virus infection using a structured questionnaire. Data were analysed using SPSS version 27.0. Descriptive statistics were used. The normality of the data was assessed using the Kolmogorov-Smirnov and Shapiro-Wilk tests. Owing to the non-normality of the data, the chi-square test was applied to determine the association between categorical variables. Statistical significance was set at P < 0.05.Results: The mean age of the participants was 21.6 ± 0.54 years. Of the 72 nursing students, 62.5% of the students had heard about Nipah virus, while 63.9% correctly identified it as a viral infection. About 80.6% knew about its transmission to others. 52.8% were adequately aware of the natural reservoirs of Nipah virus. Most (68.1%) students identified encephalitis as a significant complication. Preventive measures like avoiding partially eaten fruits (73.6%), using personal protective equipment (83.3%), hand hygiene (76.4%), and isolation of cases (84.7%) were broadly acknowledged. Most (61.1%) received information about this deadly virus from social media. Significant associations were observed between age groups and knowledge of the natural reservoir (P < 0.05) and isolation from cases as a preventive practice (P < 0.02). Conclusion: Nursing students had moderate awareness of Nipah virus infection. Social media played a pivotal role in knowledge acquisition about the Nipah virus. Keywords: Nipah virus, nursing students, encephalitis, natural reservoir, social media.

Owing to the non-normality of the data, the chi-square test was applied to determine the association between categorical variables. Statistical significance was set at P < 0.05.
analysis.main_results: Of the 72 nursing students, 62.5% of the students had heard about Nipah virus, while 63.9% correctly identified it as a viral infection. About 80.6% knew about its transmission to others. 52.8% were adequately aware of the natural reservoirs of Nipah virus. Most (68.1%) students identified encephalitis as a significant complication. Preventive measures like avoiding partially eaten fruits (73.6%), using personal protective equipment (83.3%), hand hygiene (76.4%), and isolation of cases (84.7%) were broadly acknowledged. analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as indicating that nursing students had moderate awareness of Nipah virus infection. The novelty of the study lies in its focus on the knowledge levels of nursing students, a group critical to outbreak response and patient care.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform targeted educational interventions to improve awareness of Nipah virus infection among nursing students, which is crucial for effective outbreak management and patient safety.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design and reliance on self-reported data. The evidence strength is moderate, as the study provides descriptive insights into awareness levels but does not establish causality or long-term trends.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study assessed the awareness of 72 nursing students about Nipah virus infection. The study found that 62.5% of participants had heard about the virus, with 63.9% correctly identifying it as a viral infection. Most students were aware of its transmission and preventive measures, though knowledge about natural reservoirs was lower. The authors concluded that nursing students had moderate awareness of Nipah virus, with social media being a key source of information. The study highlights the need for improved education on Nipah virus among healthcare professionals to enhance preparedness and response during outbreaks. However, the study's cross-sectional design and reliance on self-reported data limit the confidence in its findings, resulting in a moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.methods: 通过结构化问卷收集了有关护理专业学生对尼帕病毒感染的认知数据,包括其病原体、临床表现、并发症及预防措施。数据使用SPSS 27.0版本进行分析,采用描述性统计方法。通过Kolmogorov-Smirnov和Shapiro-Wilk检验评估数据的正态性。由于数据非正态分布,采用卡方检验来确定分类变量之间的关联。统计学显著性设定为P < 0.05。
elements_zh.main_results: 在72名护理专业学生中,62.5%的学生听说过尼帕病毒,而63.9%的学生正确识别其为病毒感染。约80.6%的学生了解其传播方式。52.8%的学生对尼帕病毒的自然宿主有充分认知。大多数(68.1%)学生认为脑炎是该感染的重要并发症。避免食用部分腐烂的水果(73.6%)、使用个人防护装备(83.3%)、手卫生(76.4%)以及病例隔离(84.7%)等预防措施被广泛认可。大多数(61.1%)学生通过社交媒体获取了关于这种致命病毒的信息。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为护理专业学生对尼帕病毒感染的认知处于中等水平。本研究的创新之处在于关注护理专业学生这一群体对尼帕病毒感染的认知水平,这对暴发的应对和患者护理至关重要。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为制定针对性的教育干预措施提供依据,以提高护理专业学生对尼帕病毒感染的认知水平,这对于有效的暴发管理及患者安全至关重要。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其横断面设计和依赖于自我报告的数据。证据强度中等,因为该研究仅提供了对认知水平的描述性见解,而未能建立因果关系或长期趋势。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to determine the awareness of nursing students regarding Nipah virus infection. The scientific and public-health problem lies in the lack of understanding about Nipah virus among healthcare professionals, which could impact outbreak preparedness and patient care.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional analytical study was conducted among 72 nursing students from a public sector nursing college. The study focused on assessing their knowledge about Nipah virus infection, including epidemiology, clinical features, prevention, and transmission.
analysis_en.methods: Data were gathered pertaining to their knowledge of the epidemiology, clinical manifestations, complications, and prevention of Nipah virus infection using a structured questionnaire. Data were analysed using SPSS version 27.0. Descriptive statistics were used. The normality of the data was assessed using the Kolmogorov-Smirnov and Shapiro-Wilk tests. Owing to the non-normality of the data, the chi-square test was applied to determine the association between categorical variables. Statistical significance was set at P < 0.05.
analysis_en.main_results: Of the 72 nursing students, 62.5% of the students had heard about Nipah virus, while 63.9% correctly identified it as a viral infection. About 80.6% knew about its transmission to others. 52.8% were adequately aware of the natural reservoirs of Nipah virus. Most (68.1%) students identified encephalitis as a significant complication. Preventive measures like avoiding partially eaten fruits (73.6%), using personal protective equipment (83.3%), hand hygiene (76.4%), and isolation of cases (84.7%) were broadly acknowledged. Most (61.1%) received information about this deadly virus from social media.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as indicating that nursing students had moderate awareness of Nipah virus infection. The novelty of the study lies in its focus on the knowledge levels of nursing students, a group critical to outbreak response and patient care.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform targeted educational interventions to improve awareness of Nipah virus infection among nursing students, which is crucial for effective outbreak management and patient safety.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design and reliance on self-reported data. The evidence strength is moderate, as the study provides descriptive insights into awareness levels but does not establish causality or long-term trends.

papers.title_zh: 护理专业学生对尼帕病毒感染的认知:一项横断面研究
papers.source_body_en: Objective: This study aimed to determine the awareness of nursing students regarding Nipah virus infection. Methods: A cross-sectional analytical study was conducted among 72 nursing students from a public sector nursing college. Data were gathered pertaining to their knowledge of the epidemiology, clinical manifestations, complications, and prevention of Nipah virus infection using a structured questionnaire. Data were analysed using SPSS version 27.0. Descriptive statistics were used. The normality of the data was assessed using the Kolmogorov-Smirnov and Shapiro-Wilk tests. Owing to the non-normality of the data, the chi-square test was applied to determine the association between categorical variables. Statistical significance was set at P < 0.05.Results: The mean age of the participants was 21.6 ± 0.54 years. Of the 72 nursing students, 62.5% of the students had heard about Nipah virus, while 63.9% correctly identified it as a viral infection. About 80.6% knew about its transmission to others. 52.8% were adequately aware of the natural reservoirs of Nipah virus. Most (68.1%) students identified encephalitis as a significant complication. Preventive measures like avoiding partially eaten fruits (73.6%), using personal protective equipment (83.3%), hand hygiene (76.4%), and isolation of cases (84.7%) were broadly acknowledged. Most (61.1%) received information about this deadly virus from social media. Significant associations were observed between age groups and knowledge of the natural reservoir (P < 0.05) and isolation from cases as a preventive practice (P < 0.02). Conclusion: Nursing students had moderate awareness of Nipah virus infection. Social media played a pivotal role in knowledge acquisition about the Nipah virus. Keywords: Nipah virus, nursing students, encephalitis, natural reservoir, social media.
papers.abstract_zh: 目的:本研究旨在评估护理专业学生对尼帕病毒感染的认知情况。方法:在一所公立护理学院的72名护理专业学生中开展了一项横断面分析研究。通过结构化问卷收集了有关他们对尼帕病毒感染的认知数据,包括其病原体、临床表现、并发症及预防措施。数据使用SPSS 27.0版本进行分析,采用描述性统计方法。通过Kolmogorov-Smirnov和Shapiro-Wilk检验评估数据的正态性。由于数据非正态分布,采用卡方检验来确定分类变量之间的关联。统计学显著性设定为P < 0.05。结果:参与者的平均年龄为21.6 ± 0.54岁。在72名护理专业学生中,62.5%的学生听说过尼帕病毒,而63.9%的学生正确识别其为病毒感染。约80.6%的学生了解其传播方式。52.8%的学生对尼帕病毒的自然宿主有充分认知。大多数(68.1%)学生认为脑炎是该感染的重要并发症。避免食用部分腐烂的水果(73.6%)、使用个人防护装备(83.3%)、手卫生(76.4%)以及病例隔离(84.7%)等预防措施被广泛认可。大多数(61.1%)学生通过社交媒体获取了关于这种致命病毒的信息。观察到年龄组与对自然宿主认知(P < 0.05)以及病例隔离作为预防措施(P < 0.02)之间存在显著关联。结论:护理专业学生对尼帕病毒感染的认知处于中等水平。社交媒体在该病毒感染知识获取中发挥了关键作用。关键词:尼帕病毒,护理专业学生,脑炎,自然宿主,社交媒体。

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to identify synthetic small molecules from Tinospora cordifolia that could inhibit Nipah virus fusion, addressing the need for effective antiviral agents against this emerging pathogen.
analysis.study_design_and_population: An in silico study was conducted to screen compounds derived from Tinospora cordifolia for their potential to block Nipah virus fusion, focusing on molecular interactions without involving experimental testing on biological systems.
analysis.methods: The research utilized computational methods to analyze the molecular structure of Tinospora cordifolia compounds and their potential interaction with Nipah virus fusion proteins, based on existing literature and databases.
analysis.main_results: The study identified several synthetic small molecules from Tinospora cordifolia that showed potential for inhibiting Nipah virus fusion, though no experimental validation was provided.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that Tinospora cordifolia may contain compounds with antiviral potential against Nipah virus, offering a novel direction for drug discovery in the context of viral fusion inhibition.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results could inform future research into natural products for antiviral development, potentially contributing to the surveillance and treatment strategies for Nipah virus infections.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on in silico data without experimental verification, resulting in moderate confidence in the proposed antiviral activity of the identified compounds.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the potential of synthetic small molecules from Tinospora cordifolia to inhibit Nipah virus fusion through in silico analysis. The research is motivated by the need for effective antiviral agents against Nipah virus, which is a significant emerging pathogen. The methods involve computational screening of compounds based on molecular interactions with the virus. The main results suggest several compounds may have antiviral potential, though no experimental validation was conducted. The interpretation highlights the novelty of using Tinospora cordifolia as a source for antiviral drug discovery. The findings could inform future research into natural products for antiviral development, particularly in the context of Nipah virus infections. However, the study's reliance on in silico data without experimental verification limits the confidence in its conclusions, resulting in a moderate assessment of evidence strength.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究采用基于计算机模拟的方法,筛选来自Tinospora cordifolia的化合物,评估其潜在阻断尼帕病毒融合的能力,重点研究分子相互作用,而不涉及对生物系统的实验测试。

elements_zh.main_results: 本研究识别出几种来自Tinospora cordifolia的合成小分子,显示出抑制尼帕病毒融合的潜力,尽管未提供实验验证。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,Tinospora cordifolia可能含有针对尼帕病毒的具有抗病毒药物潜力的化合物,为病毒融合抑制的药物发现提供了新的方向。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可能为未来研究天然产物用于抗病毒药物药物开发提供信息,可能有助于监测和治疗策略应对尼帕病毒感染。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究依赖于计算机模拟数据,缺乏实验验证,因此所提出化合物的抗病毒药物活性的可信度中等。

papers.title: TransmiRisk-AI: an agentic AI-based risk assessment framework for zoonotic diseases using integrated surveillance data
papers.abstract: Introduction Zoonotic disease outbreaks are increasing in frequency and complexity, highlighting the need for intelligent surveillance systems capable of real-time monitoring and risk assessment. Existing surveillance approaches are often reactive, fragmented, and dependent on manual analysis, limiting timely public health responses. Methods This study presents TransmiRisk-AI, an agentic AI-driven surveillance framework designed to support automated zoonotic disease risk monitoring and decision-making. The framework integrates a hybrid risk scoring model with a multi-agent architecture comprising data ingestion, risk assessment, alert generation, execution, logging, and orchestration agents. These agents collaboratively automate data collection, preprocessing, risk evaluation, outbreak monitoring, and alert dissemination. To enhance situational awareness, the system incorporates outbreak intelligence from WHO Disease Outbreak News and dynamically updates disease risk profiles based on outbreak recency, frequency, and severity. An interactive Streamlit dashboard provides transparent visualization of risk categories, outbreak trends, and system activities. Results Case studies involving the Nipah virus and Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever demonstrate the framework's ability to adapt to evolving epidemiological conditions. Discussion TransmiRisk-AI offers a scalable and interpretable digital health solution that supports proactive surveillance and timely decision-making within a One Health context.

papers.abstract_zh: 引言 人兽共患病的暴发正在增加其频率和复杂性,凸显了需要能够进行实时监测和风险评估的智能监测系统的重要性。现有的监测方法往往具有反应性、碎片化且依赖于手动分析,限制了公共卫生的及时响应。方法 本研究提出了TransmiRisk-AI,一种基于代理的AI驱动监测框架,旨在支持人兽共患病风险的自动化监测和决策。该框架集成了混合风险评分模型与包含数据摄入、风险评估、警报生成、执行、日志记录和协调代理的多代理架构。这些代理协同工作,以自动化数据收集、预处理、风险评估、暴发监测以及警报传播。为了增强情境感知,系统从WHO疾病暴发新闻中整合暴发情报,并根据暴发的近期性、频率和严重程度动态更新疾病风险档案。一个交互式的Streamlit仪表板提供了风险类别、暴发趋势和系统活动的透明可视化。结果 涉及尼帕病毒和克里米亚-刚果出血热的案例研究展示了该框架适应不断演变的流行病学条件的能力。讨论 TransmiRisk-AI提供了一种可扩展且可解释的数字健康解决方案,支持在One Health背景下进行主动的监测和及时的决策。科学与公共卫生意义 为了增强情境感知,系统从WHO疾病暴发新闻中整合暴发情报,并根据暴发的近期性、频率和严重程度动态更新疾病风险档案。局限性与证据强度 一个交互式的Streamlit仪表板提供了风险类别、暴发趋势和系统活动的透明可视化。

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 为增强态势感知能力,该系统整合了来自世界卫生组织疾病暴发新闻的暴发情报,并根据暴发的近期性、频率和严重程度动态更新疾病风险概况。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 一个交互式的Streamlit仪表盘提供了风险类别、暴发趋势和系统活动的透明可视化。

Updated : 15 September 2023, 16:12 • DISEASE SHARE AFP, New Delhi Health workers wearing protective gear shift people who have been in contact with a person infected with the Nipah virus to an isolation center at a government hospital in Kozikode, in India's Kerala state on September 14, 2023. Photo: AFP Authorities in India are scrambling to contain a rare outbreak of Nipah, a virus spread from animals to humans that causes deadly fever with a high mortality rate. Here is a look at what we know so far: Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source What is the Nipah virus? The first Nipah outbreak was recorded in 1998 after the virus spread among pig farmers in Malaysia. The virus is named after the village where it was discovered. Outbreaks are rare but Nipah has been listed by the World Health Organization (WHO) -- alongside Ebola, Zika and Covid-19 -- as one of several diseases deserving of priority research for their potential to cause a global epidemic. Nipah usually spreads to humans from animals or through contaminated food, but it can also be transmitted directly between people. Fruit bats are the natural carriers of the virus and have been identified as the most likely cause of subsequent outbreaks. Symptoms include intense fever, vomiting and a respiratory infection, but severe cases can involve seizures and brain inflammation that results in a coma. There is no vaccine for Nipah. Patients have a mortality rate of between 40 and 75 percent depending on the public health response to the virus, the WHO says. What has happened during previous outbreaks? The first Nipah outbreak killed more than 100 people in Malaysia and prompted the culling of one million pigs in an effort to contain the virus. It also spread to Singapore, with 11 cases and one death among slaughterhouse workers who came into contact with pigs imported from Malaysia. Since then, the disease has mainly been recorded in Bangladesh and India, with both countries reporting their first outbreaks in 2001. Bangladesh has borne the brunt in recent years, with more than 100 people dying of Nipah since 2001. Two early outbreaks in India killed more than 50 people before they were brought under control. The southern state of Kerala has recorded two deaths from Nipah and four other confirmed cases since last month. Authorities there have closed some schools and instituted mass testing. This marks Kerala's fourth recorded spate of Nipah cases in five years. The virus killed 17 people during the first instance in 2018. The state has managed to stamp out previous outbreaks within a matter of weeks through widespread testing and strict isolation of those in contact with patients. Are animal-to-human viruses becoming more frequent? Having first appeared thousands of years ago, zoonoses -- diseases that can be transmitted from animals to humans -- have multiplied over the past 20 to 30 years. For all latest news, follow The Daily Star's Google News channel. The growth of international travel has allowed them to spread more quickly. By occupying increasingly large areas of the planet, experts say, humans also contribute to disruption of the ecosystem and increase the likelihood of random virus mutations that are transmissible to humans. Industrial farming increases the risk of pathogens spreading between animals while deforestation heightens contact between wildlife, domestic animals and humans. By mixing more, species will transmit their viruses more, which will promote the emergence of new diseases potentially transmissible to humans. Climate change will push many animals to flee their ecosystems for more livable lands, a study published by the scientific journal Nature warned in 2022. According to estimates published in the journal Science in 2018, there are 1.7 million unknown viruses in mammals and birds, 540,000-850,000 of them with the capacity to infect humans. Donate Home » New EU project aims to create first breathable treatment for Nipah virus Share this on News New EU project aims to create first breathable treatment for Nipah virus A new EU-funded project that aims to develop the world’s first breathable treatment for Nipah virus infection has officially launched this month (1 September 2026). 30/09/2026 Over the next six years, the Horizon-funded initiative, HENIPROTECT, will bring together 18 partners across eight countries to tackle one of the most concerning emerging infectious diseases. What is Nipah virus? Nipah virus is a highly dangerous virus carried by fruit bats, which can host the virus without becoming ill themselves. These bats are widespread across parts of South-East Asia and Australia. While the virus usually spreads from animals to humans, it can also pass between people. This raises important concerns about possible future pandemics and preparing for them. Outbreaks tend to occur in rural or farming areas. Symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, cough and difficulty breathing. The infection can be severe and lead to death in up to 75 out of every 100 people who catch it. The World Health Organization (WHO) has classified Nipah virus as a ‘priority infectious disease’ and included it in its ‘Blueprint list’. This list highlights infectious diseases that pose the greatest risk to global health because they have the potential to cause major outbreaks or epidemics, and we currently lack adequate vaccines, cures, or treatments to stop them. Currently, there are no licensed preventions or treatments available – but the HENIPROTECT project aims to change this. What are the aims of HENIPROTECT? Supporting the European Union’s priorities to strengthen health security and prepare for potential future pandemics, HENIPROTECT aims to develop a new antibody treatment for the Nipah virus delivered by inhalation. This means it is delivered straight to the lungs by breathing it in. Antibodies are proteins the body makes naturally to fight off infections. When a virus or bacteria enters the body, antibodies recognise it and stop it from causing harm. An antibody treatment provides ready-made antibodies instead of waiting for the body to make its own. What will the project do? The project will: Look at an antibody (called Nip35) that targets the Nipah virus and look at how it can be used in humans Combine two antibodies that work in different ways for better protection against the virus Test giving the antibody through breathing it in (inhalation) using mesh-nebulisation so it goes directly to the lungs where the virus infects Set up manufacturing to produce the treatment to regulatory standards (this is known as Good Manufacturing Practice or GMP) Run a human clinical trial in healthy volunteers to test safety Develop a toolbox to counter emerging variants of the virus. The European Lung Foundation (ELF) will lead public-facing activities in the project and will be responsible for translating the scientific results into lay language for patients, carers, and the general public through various communication platforms. The European Respiratory Society (ERS) will lead scientific dissemination and overall communication planning. Through Lungs Europe, ELF and ERS will lead advocacy efforts, working to ensure Nipah virus remains on the EU health agenda. Overall, the project will not only deliver a crucial treatment for Nipah virus, but also establish a valuable blueprint for responding rapidly to future respiratory viral threats, in particular to other viruses of the same Henipavirus genus, like highly pathogenic Hendra virus. analysis.time: The project was launched on 1 September 2026, with the publication date being 30 September 2026.
analysis.location_and_population: The project, HENIPROTECT, involves 18 partners across eight countries and focuses on Nipah virus, which is prevalent in rural or farming areas of South-East Asia and Australia.
analysis.event: A new EU-funded project, HENIPROTECT, aims to develop the world’s first breathable treatment for Nipah virus infection. The European Lung Foundation (ELF) and the European Respiratory Society (ERS) are leading public-facing activities and scientific dissemination, respectively.
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: Nipah virus is classified as a ‘priority infectious disease’ by the WHO, with a high mortality rate of up to 75% in infected individuals. The project aims to address the lack of licensed preventions or treatments for this virus.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: The project is in its initial phase, with plans to develop a new antibody treatment, test it in humans, and establish manufacturing standards. The European Lung Foundation will translate scientific results into lay language for public understanding.

analysis.brief_en: A new EU-funded project, HENIPROTECT, has launched to develop the world’s first breathable treatment for Nipah virus infection. The initiative, which began on 1 September 2026, involves 18 partners across eight countries and aims to address the lack of effective treatments for this highly dangerous virus. Nipah virus, carried by fruit bats in South-East Asia and Australia, can cause severe illness with a mortality rate of up to 75%. The European Lung Foundation (ELF) will lead public communication, translating scientific findings into lay language for patients and the general public. The project plans to test an antibody treatment through inhalation, develop a clinical trial, and create a blueprint for responding to future respiratory viral threats. The European Respiratory Society (ERS) will manage scientific dissemination, while advocacy efforts will be led through Lungs Europe. This project is part of the EU’s broader strategy to enhance health security and prepare for potential pandemics.

Nipah virus, carried by fruit bats in South-East Asia and Australia, can cause severe illness with a mortality rate of up to 75%. The European Lung Foundation (ELF) will lead public communication, translating scientific findings into lay language for patients and the general public. The project plans to test an antibody treatment through inhalation, develop a clinical trial, and create a blueprint for responding to future respiratory viral threats. The European Respiratory Society (ERS) will manage scientific dissemination, while advocacy efforts will be led through Lungs Europe. This project is part of the EU’s broader strategy to enhance health security and prepare for potential pandemics.

news.title_zh: 新欧盟项目旨在开发首个可呼吸的治疗用于尼帕病毒感染 - 欧洲肺部基金会
news.source_body_en: A new EU-funded project, HENIPROTECT, has launched to develop the world’s first breathable treatment for Nipah virus infection. The initiative, which began on 1 September 2026, involves 18 partners across eight countries and aims to address the lack of effective treatments for this highly dangerous virus. Nipah virus, carried by fruit bats in South-East Asia and Australia, can cause severe illness with a mortality rate of up to 75%. The European Lung Foundation (ELF) will lead public communication, translating scientific findings into lay language for patients and the general public. The project plans to test an antibody treatment through inhalation, develop a clinical trial, and create a blueprint for responding to future respiratory viral threats. The European Respiratory Society (ERS) will manage scientific dissemination, while advocacy efforts will be led through Lungs Europe. This project is part of the EU’s broader strategy to enhance health security and prepare for potential pandemics.
news.content_zh: 一项新的欧盟资助项目HENIPROTECT已启动,旨在开发世界上首个可呼吸的治疗用于尼帕病毒感染。该计划于2026年9月1日开始,涉及来自八个欧洲国家的18个合作伙伴,旨在解决目前缺乏针对这种高度危险病毒的有效治疗的问题。尼帕病毒由南亚和澳大利亚的果蝠携带,可导致严重疾病,其死亡率高达75%。欧洲肺部基金会(ELF)将负责公众沟通,将科学发现转化为通俗语言,以供患者和公众理解。该项目计划通过吸入方式测试一种抗体治疗,开展临床试验,并制定应对未来呼吸道病毒威胁的蓝图。欧洲呼吸学会(ERS)将负责科学传播,而倡导活动将由Lungs Europe主导。该项目是欧盟更广泛战略的一部分,旨在增强卫生安全并为潜在的流行病做好准备。

5 October 2026 • In Focus Is Bangladesh prepared for the next food shock? 4 October 2026 • Big Picture Can Bangladesh capitalise on the Bay of Bengal’s strategic rise? 4 October 2026 • Geopolitical Insights Nipah virus explained: How it spreads and how Bangladesh can stay safe Updated : 29 January 2026, 16:28 • HEALTH & FITNESS SHARE A Ayman Anika Ayman Anika Photo: Collected / gabby k / Pexels For many of us, the word “Nipah” is not abstract. It carries memories of quarantined villages, restricted movement, and anxious nights spent waiting for test results. With new Nipah cases reported in neighbouring India, and airports across Asia stepping up screening, the concern feels immediate — not distant. Nipah virus is not new to Bangladesh. Since the first recorded outbreak in 2001, the country has seen repeated cases almost every year, particularly in winter. Unlike many infectious diseases that arrive from elsewhere, Nipah is already part of our ecological reality. Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source How Nipah spreads Fruit bats are the natural carriers of the Nipah virus. In Bangladesh, transmission to humans most commonly occurs through raw date palm sap contaminated by bat saliva or urine. The practice of drinking fresh, unprocessed sap remains one of the biggest risk factors. The virus can also spread by eating fruits partially eaten or contaminated by bats, through close contact with infected animals, and from human to human via bodily fluids such as saliva, respiratory droplets, blood, or urine. Several outbreaks in Bangladesh have shown clear evidence of person-to-person transmission, especially among family members and caregivers. This makes Nipah particularly dangerous in household and hospital settings where close contact is unavoidable. Symptoms that should not be ignored Nipah infection does not always start dramatically. Early symptoms often include fever, headache, muscle pain, sore throat, and fatigue — signs that can easily be mistaken for flu or viral fever. In more severe cases, the virus attacks the brain, leading to encephalitis. Symptoms may escalate quickly to dizziness, confusion, seizures, difficulty breathing, and loss of consciousness. The disease can progress within days. Fatality rates reported in South Asia range between 40 and 75 per cent. Survivors may suffer long-term neurological complications, including memory loss, personality changes, and difficulty concentrating. There is no specific antiviral treatment and no approved vaccine. Medical care focuses on supportive treatment, which makes early detection critical. Why this matters right now Recent cases in India, particularly in West Bengal, are geographically close to Bangladesh. While Nipah does not spread easily through casual contact or air travel, authorities have increased airport screening as a precaution. These steps are meant to detect symptoms early, not to signal widespread danger. For Bangladesh, the bigger challenge lies at home. Rural awareness remains uneven, and seasonal behaviours — especially consuming raw date palm sap — continue despite years of warnings. What prevention actually looks like Preventing Nipah does not require drastic lifestyle changes, but it does require consistency. Avoiding raw or fermented date palm sap is one of the most effective measures. Fruits should be washed thoroughly and not eaten if visibly bitten or damaged. People should avoid close contact with sick animals and seek medical attention if they develop a fever after possible exposure. Caregivers should use protective measures when looking after suspected patients, especially in home settings. Nipah is not a virus that spreads silently across cities. It spreads through habits, proximity, and delayed response. For us, vigilance is not about panic. It is about recognising a familiar threat, understanding how it moves, and choosing prevention over regret. For all latest news, follow The Daily Star's Google News channel. news.content_zh: 《每日星报》于2026年10月2日发表的文章解释了尼帕病毒及其对孟加拉国的风险。文章指出,该病毒自2001年起就在该国存在,主要通过被蝙蝠唾液或尿液污染的生枣椰树汁传播。文章提到,近期邻国印度的病例引发了关注,促使亚洲地区加强机场筛查。尽管目前尚无针对抗病毒药物、治疗或疫苗的特异性药物或治疗方法,预防措施包括避免饮用生枣椰树汁、彻底清洗水果以及在可能暴露后寻求医疗帮助。文章强调,尼帕病毒的传播与习惯和近距离接触有关,而非通过航空旅行传播,并呼吁保持警惕而非恐慌。文章还指出,早期发现和持续的预防措施对于减轻病毒影响至关重要,尤其是在农村地区,生枣椰树汁的消费仍然普遍。

5 October 2026 • In Focus Is Bangladesh prepared for the next food shock? 4 October 2026 • Big Picture Can Bangladesh capitalise on the Bay of Bengal’s strategic rise? 4 October 2026 • Geopolitical Insights First Nipah virus death of 2026 reported in Naogaon: IEDCR Updated : 7 February 2026, 17:23 • BANGLADESH SHARE Star Online Report Bangladesh recorded its first Nipah virus (NiV) death this year when a woman from Naogaon died on January 28 with symptoms of the virus, officials confirmed. “We carried out the necessary tests after being informed that a woman had been admitted to hospital with Nipah virus symptoms and confirmed that she died of Nipah,” Shamin Sultana, senior scientific officer of the Institute of Epidemiology, Disease Control and Research (IEDCR), told The Daily Star today. Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source After August last year, this is the first Nipah virus death in the country, she said, adding that a total of four people died from the virus in 2025. The patient was a woman aged between 40 and 50 and a resident of Naogaon, according to the World Health Organisation’s (WHO) Disease Outbreak News released on Friday. She developed symptoms consistent with NiV infection on January 21, including fever, headache, muscle cramps, loss of appetite, weakness, and vomiting, followed by hypersalivation, disorientation, and convulsions. On January 27, she became unconscious and was referred by a local physician to a tertiary hospital. She was admitted on January 28, and the Nipah surveillance team collected throat swabs and blood samples. The patient died the same day. The patient had reported repeated consumption of raw date palm sap between January 5 and 20. Following the confirmed diagnosis, an outbreak investigation team began investigations on January 30, and a total of 35 contacts have been identified. All of them tested negative but are being kept under observation, Shamin said. Since 2001, Bangladesh has documented 348 NiV cases, including 250 deaths, corresponding to an overall case fatality rate of 72 percent, according to WHO. Nearly half of these cases were primary cases with a confirmed history of consuming raw date palm sap or “tari” (fermented date palm sap), while 29 percent resulted from direct person-to-person transmission. Most cases in Bangladesh are reported from December to April, suggesting a seasonal pattern. According to IEDCR data, five people were infected in 2024 and all of them died. In 2023, 13 people were infected, of whom 10 died. Nipah virus is a zoonotic pathogen with a high death rate and no licensed vaccine or treatment, though early supportive treatment can save lives, according to WHO. It is transmitted to humans through infected animals such as bats, or via food contaminated with saliva, urine, or excreta of infected animals. It can also be transmitted directly from person to person through close contact with an infected individual. Fruit bats, also known as flying foxes, are the natural reservoir of the virus. news.content: Add ANI As A Trusted Source For Reliable Information Tue, Oct 06, 2026 |Updated 09:40 IST Toggle navigation Toggle navigation National General News Politics Features Business Entertainment Bollywood Hollywood Music Out of box Sports Cricket Football Others Tennis Hockey World Asia US Europe Pacific Others Middle East Health Tech Mobile Internet Science Others Videos National World Entertainment Sports Business Toggle navigation All you need to know about Nipah virus outbreak in Kerala Updated:3 years ago Kozhikode (Kerala), September 18 (ANI): Giving a significant update on the current situation of the Nipah Virus in Kerala and the state’s response to the virus outbreak, Kerala Health Minister Veena George said that ICMR and WHO had conducted studies on the issue and it was found that 9 states in India have the probability of Nipah occurrence and Kerala is one among them. She further said, “Also after 2018, we conducted surveillance and we found that the source of Nipah infection is bats. The virus we found in Kerala is identified as Indian Genotype or I Genotype which is similar to the strain found in Bangladesh. We have two strains of Nipah Virus one is Malaysian and the other from Bangladesh." The Health Minister's update underscores the government's commitment to swiftly and comprehensively address the Nipah virus situation in Kerala. Authorities are leaving no stone unturned in their efforts to contain the outbreak, trace contacts, and gather critical scientific data for a more informed response. Public health remains the top priority as the state works diligently to manage this health challenge. news.source_body_en: The Nipah virus outbreak in Kerala, India, has been the subject of recent updates from the state's Health Minister, Veena George. According to the information provided, the Indian Genotype of Nipah virus, similar to the strain found in Bangladesh, has been identified as the cause of the outbreak. The health minister mentioned that ICMR and WHO studies have indicated that nine Indian states, including Kerala, have a probability of Nipah occurrence. She emphasized that the source of the infection is bats, and that authorities are conducting thorough investigations, contact tracing, and data collection to manage the outbreak effectively. news.content_zh: 印度喀拉拉邦的尼帕病毒 暴发近期引起了该邦卫生部长维娜·乔治的更新。根据提供的信息,印度基因型的尼帕病毒与孟加拉国发现的菌株相似,已被确认为导致暴发的原因。卫生部长提到,印度医学研究理事会(ICMR)和世界卫生组织(WHO)的研究表明,包括喀拉拉邦在内的9个印度邦存在尼帕病毒爆发的可能性。她强调,感染源是蝙蝠,并指出当局正在开展全面调查、接触者追踪和数据收集工作,以有效应对暴发。应对工作仍在进行中,公共卫生是首要任务。尽管暴发尚未完全控制,政府正采取综合措施应对这一情况。

news.content: Skip to main content E-PAPER ARCHIVE Today's FE AUTO বাংলা Tuesday • 6 October 2026 Home Economy▾ Stock▾ Trade National▾ World▾ Editorial Views▾ More categories▾ OUR CORRESPOMDENT Published: Jan 19, 2024, 04:56 Share this news Country | 2 years ago Farmer dies of Nipah virus infection in Pabna OUR CORRESPOMDENT Published: Jan 19, 2024, 04:56 PABNA, Jan 18: A 42-year-old farmer died of Nipah virus infection in Ishwardi upazila of Pabna district on Wednesday night while he was undergoing treatment at the National Institute of Neuro Sciences and Hospital in the capital. Medical Literature & Resources The deceased was identified as Khokon Malitha, son of former Ishwardi upazila chairman late Rostam Ali Malitha, a resident of Pratirajpur village of Ishwardi upazila of the district. According to local and family sources, a week ago, Khokon Malitha suddenly fell ill after consuming date juice. His family got him admitted to local upazila health complex. He was then transferred to Rajshahi. Later, when his condition deteriorated, he was sent to the National Institute of Neuro Sciences and Hospital in the capital. He died on Wednesday night while undergoing treatment there. Pabna civil surgeon Dr. Shahidullah Dewan confirmed it to this correspondent on Thursday. He said, "We have confirmed that Khokon Malitha died of Nipah virus. Our medical team has been sent to the spot. The report of the medical team should be sent to Dhaka". motiarfe@gmail.com OUR CORRESPOMDENT Published: Jan 19, 2024, 04:56 Share this news Our Correspondent Published: Oct 05, 2026, 07:24 Share this news Country | 20 hours agoNARROW SLUICE GATES AT CHAKTAI CANAL Traders pay twice for goods transportation from Chaktai-Khatunganj The photo shows an aerial view of the Chaktai Canal and sluice gate at the Chaktai-Khatunganj trade hub in Chattogram town. — FE photo Infectious Diseases Our Correspondent Published: Oct 05, 2026, 07:24 CHATTOGRAM: Large boats have been unable to enter the Chaktai-Khatunganj trade hub due to narrow sluice gates at the confluence of Chaktai Canal and Karnaphuli River, allowing only small boats to enter, which traders say had doubled their cost for goods transportation. Traders also say that approximately 10 per cent of the country's goods are currently being transported from the hub and the volume of trade has fallen due to navigability crisis in the canal. Before the Chattogram Development Authority (CDA) constructed the sluice gates, large trawlers were able to anchor near small docking points at the hub and goods could have been directly loaded onto them. Now, however, small boats carry the produce first, before they are loaded onto large boats, which are then used for transportion to different parts of the country, including the capital. During the construction phase of the sluice gates, traders have raised the issue of transport hindarance, but, allegedly, the CDA had not paid any heed to them. Rafiq Ullah, president of the Chattogram Rice Mill Owners' Association, said, "Large quantities of paddy used to arrive at Chaktai from Hatiya and Subarnachar in Noakhali, as well as from Sandwip in Chattogram; additionally, rice was transported from there to Moheshkhali and Kutubdia in Cox's Bazar. However, the volume of goods transported via waterways has declined significantly due to various factors-most notably the presence of sluice gates, which prevent large boats from docking at the Chaktai canal ghat. Currently, only about 10 per cent of goods are transported by water." Geographic Reference Abul Kashem, president of Chaktai Aratdar and Traders' Association, said, "Water no longer enters the traders' shops and warehouses-thanks to the construction of the sluice gate. However, had the gate's entrance been wider and its height greater, large boats could have easily entered the Chaktai Canal. Before construction began, we had requested the then-CDA chairman to ensure the design accommodated the entry of large boats; since that was not done, we are now forced to transport goods using boats in two stages. This is causing hardship for traders. Moreover, with one side of the canal now filled in, even small boats struggle to enter properly-whereas, at one time, eight to ten large boats used to be moored in the Chaktai Canal." Md. Mohiuddin, general secretary of the Chaktai-Khatunganj Wholesalers and General Traders Welfare Association said, "Approximately 10 per cent of goods are currently being transported via waterways in the Chaktai-Khatunganj area. While the sluice gate has been beneficial in one respect, it has caused harm in another; this situation could have been avoided had proper planning been implemented during its construction. In the past, large boats used to dock directly at the landing points adjacent to the traders' shops. That is no longer possible. Consequently, the need to transfer goods between small and large boats has resulted in additional costs for shipping merchandise to Kutubdia, Moheshkhali, Sandwip, and Hatiya." Health nazimuddinshyamol@gmail.com Our Correspondent Published: Oct 05, 2026, 07:24 Share this news
